why: Paragraph 102 states that a half-burned wax vesta was found in the mud.

text: Why was a match struck in the hollow?
why: A half-burned match in the hollow is enough to make a reader ask why someone struck it there, and the question does not point to an answer.

text: Why was a match struck in the hollow? — to light his pipe
why: Straker's pockets held a briar pipe, tobacco and a box of vestas, so lighting a pipe is an obvious possibility to consider.
